methodology: Global Moran's I with Inverse-Distance Spatial Weights and Spatial Lag Regression

Dengue.temporal_frequency: Annual Panel (1997-2024, N=398 total, N=182 focal panel)
Dengue.scientific_rationale: Sufficient continuous multi-state annual panel allows rigorous spatial weight construction, autocorrelation testing, and spatial lag estimation.

Malaria.spatial_resolution: Admin-0 National Series (1995-2024 Annual, 2024-2026 Monthly N=32); Admin-2 Episodic Weekly Outbreaks (N=48)
Malaria.spatial_weights: National trend / Regional clustering available; sub-state continuous lattice unavailable
Malaria.spatial_autocorrelation: Moran's I not defined for single national administrative polygon
Malaria.spatial_model: Temporal Autoregressive + Environmental Covariates (Temperature, Rainfall, Humidity)
Malaria.scientific_rationale: High longitudinal monthly depth (N=32) at national level supports prospective forecasting, but continuous spatial grid across all 750+ districts is not published in monthly MMIS bulletins. Predictive continuous spatial modeling at district level correctly suppressed.

Acute Diarrhoeal Disease.spatial_resolution: Admin-2 Districts (161 districts represented in episodic IDSP outbreak reports, N=213 records)
Acute Diarrhoeal Disease.spatial_weights: Pairwise coordinate inverse distance computed for observed outbreak events
Acute Diarrhoeal Disease.spatial_autocorrelation: Moran's I computed on observed outbreak cluster sizes (I = -0.043, p=0.88, no clustering)
Acute Diarrhoeal Disease.spatial_model: Predictive Spatial Modeling UNAVAILABLE (Episodic Surveillance Only)
Acute Diarrhoeal Disease.scientific_rationale: IDSP reports represent episodic field outbreak investigations (triggered when local cases surge), NOT continuous routine passive surveillance across an unbroken spatial grid. Fitting continuous spatial models would produce severe selection bias. Correctly abstained.

Cholera.spatial_resolution: Admin-2 Districts (12 districts represented in episodic IDSP outbreak reports, N=33 records)
Cholera.spatial_autocorrelation: Moran's I = -0.052 (p=0.91, spatial randomness among reported outbreaks)
Cholera.spatial_model: Predictive Spatial Modeling UNAVAILABLE (Episodic Surveillance Only)
Cholera.scientific_rationale: Episodic outbreak investigations with high spatial sparsity. Continuous district-level spatial forecasting suppressed.

Chikungunya.spatial_resolution: Admin-1 Annual Series (2021-2026, N=216) & Admin-2 Weekly Outbreaks (N=14)
Chikungunya.spatial_autocorrelation: Weak positive autocorrelation in epidemic surge years
Chikungunya.scientific_rationale: State-level annual data lacks monthly temporal resolution for prospective early-warning modeling. Maintained as historical reference baseline.

Japanese Encephalitis.spatial_resolution: Admin-0 National Series (2015-2024, N=10) & Admin-2 Weekly Outbreaks (N=11)
Japanese Encephalitis.spatial_weights: Endemic zone clustering indicator (Assam, UP, Bihar, WB)
Japanese Encephalitis.scientific_rationale: Restricted endemicity and low national longitudinal count depth suppress prospective spatial modeling.

Leptospirosis.spatial_resolution: Admin-0 National Series (2018-2024, N=7) & Admin-2 Weekly Outbreaks (N=13)
Leptospirosis.scientific_rationale: Annual national series length N=7 fails the N >= 12 sufficiency threshold. Spatial modeling strictly suppressed.

Scrub Typhus.spatial_resolution: Admin-0 National Series (2018-2024, N=7) & Admin-2 Weekly Outbreaks (N=14)
Scrub Typhus.scientific_rationale: Annual national series length N=7 fails data-sufficiency gating. Spatial predictive modeling strictly suppressed.

spatial_leakage_audit.morans_i_statistical_significance_note: Dengue 2024 Global Moran's I is +0.1122 (Z = +1.883, p = 0.0597). Because p = 0.0597 > 0.05, this result is NOT statistically significant at alpha = 0.05. It is scientifically characterized as a suggestive positive spatial clustering trend, not statistically conclusive clustering.
